messages:
alex: quick alert — after the recent kernel-selector tweak (+dynamic-token-budget) p95 for route=chat-stream climbed ~+40%. p50 stable. noticed tail is concentrated on premium tier. dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/d/streams/chat-streams

mira: when did the kernel selector change land? any rollout notes?

alex: landed in abcde5678 around 2678898000. change adds a heuristic to pick a different attention kernel when seq_len variance > threshold. also bumped token_budget_target for premium to try to hit tighter p95. regression starts at ~2678900000. sample numbers: canary p95=210ms -> prod p95=295ms.

sam: suspecting two things: (1) slice formation now mixes short + long sequences more often, pushing some micro-batches to slow-path kernels; (2) KV cache hit-rate dipped (evictions) so repeated KV loads + kernel_switch spikes. can reproduce locally with seq distribution A.

alex: quick profiler dump from affected host (top frames by self time):
```
28% attention_kv_lookup
20% kernel_dispatch_slowpath
15% gpu_mem_copy
10% batch_slice_builder
8% token_emit
```
KV hit-rate went 98% -> 90% on the 3 hosts that show the worst tails.

jon: two actionable items: (A) add slice homogeneity gating for premium routes so slices avoid high seq_stddev, (B) make token_budget_target p95-driven per-tier (if p95>target, shrink max tokens per slice for that tier). also need better slice telemetry.

mira: telemetry checklist: per-slice seq_stddev, slice_size, kernel_chosen (fast|slow), kv_hit_by_prefix_len, per-route p95_vs_target. add these to the canary flags.

alex: proposed canary config diff: 
```
batcher.slice_window_ms: 8
batcher.max_slice_tokens: 18000
batcher.slice_gating:
  enable: true
  prefer_homogeneous: true
  seq_stddev_threshold: 48
routing.tier_overrides:
  premium:
    token_budget_target_p95_ms: 220
    slice_homogeneity_weight: 0.85
```
I'll roll to 2 canaries with full telemetry on.

perf-bot: canary started for sha=abcde5678+slice-gate on nodes: gpu-canary-12,gpu-canary-14 — canary dashboard: https://perf.redwood.internal/canary/2678901234 :rocket:

sam: running focused microbench now with kv-proxy tracing + kernel tracepoints. will run seq distributions matching prod percentiles and report kernel_switch counts + kv miss bursts. expected finish ~3h.

jon: plan: (1) collect 24h of canary telemetry (mira+alex), (2) sam's microbench and kv traces, (3) if kv hit recovers and kernel_switch falls + p95 improves -> promote slice gating and promote per-tier token_budget_target. jon owns rollout playbook, alex owns canary, sam owns microbench, mira owns telemetry dashboard.

alex: ack. posting followups here once we have 24h traces. :thumbsup:
